name: Thales
description: This plugin is used to fetch the IoCs of type IPv4 from the Application > Attack Analytics > Incidents page on the Thales platform. This plugin does not support sharing of IoCs to the Thales platform. This plugin supports retraction of IoCs pulled from the Thales platform.

configuration.label: Account ID
configuration.description: Unique identifier of the account. Get Account ID from 'Account > Current Account > ID from bracket'.

configuration.label: API ID
configuration.description: API ID generated from the Thales instance. API ID can be generated from 'Account Management > User Management > My profile > API keys' page.

configuration.label: API Key
configuration.description: API Key generated from the Thales instance. API Key can be generated from 'Account Management > User Management > My profile > API keys' page.

configuration.label: Retraction Interval (in days)
configuration.description: Number of days to use as the retraction interval for Thales indicator(s) pull retraction. This parameter applies only when IoC(s) Retraction is enabled in Threat Exchange Settings. Value must be between 1 and 1800.

configuration.label: Initial Range (in days)
configuration.description: Number of days to pull the data for the initial run. Value must be between 0 and 1800.
